en: That Hannya mask got under his skin? Some might think you're not taking it seriously with that thing on.
No, it is nothing like that. But perhaps he was right. Perhaps I'm just a coward hiding behind this mask.
Nah, I wouldn't say that. Seems more like those masked wrestlers if you ask me. I don't see anything wrong with wearing a mask.
This suffering is mine alone to bear. I don't expect anyone else to understand it.
(Takes all kinds, I guess...)
Hey. Hannya-san, right? What are you moping about here for?
I remember you. Have you come to challenge me for the Victory Road qualifiers?
No, I was just wondering what you were doing there staring off into space.
I see. The people who challenge me for the Victory Road have started demanding that I show my face.
So what? You can just ignore them, can't you?
Deep down I actually wish I could fight as myself, my face bared to all.
Yeah? Then take the damn thing off.
But this hannya mask haunts me! It plants doubt in my mind that I could actually prevail without it.
In the past, though I sought to become strong, I could not overcome my fear of meeting the gaze of my rivals.
The fear that haunted me gave away my every move to foes. In the end, I could not best even those I should have defeated handily.
Then, when I wore this Hannya mask, my skill suddenly soared, and I racked up win after win.
I became invincible.
The mask contained unprecedented power!
But this isn't the real me. Lately, I've felt the desire to savor a victory that I earned myself.
This Hannya mask won't let me, though! It whispers that without it, I'd go back to being the feeble man I once was!
I couldn't bear that. I want to take off the mask, but being reduced to a puny weakling again would be a fate worse than death!
You've got it bad, all right, but I think I see the solution.
You've just got some weird delusions about what the mask can do. Don't worry, I'll put an end to them.
Come on, Hannya. If I can beat you with that mask on, I bet you'd be willing to take it off.
Are you serious? You think you can win against me in this mask?
Well... I can only hope that you're right. Here I come!
Impossible!
How could this Hannya mask allow me to lose!?
You put up a good fight, for sure, but I could see the man behind the mask. That's where your true strength lies.
Within you.
So you're saying I don't need to wear this mask anymore!?
Of course not. You can tell by now, can't you? Your fighting ability is your own.
Now that you know that, though, I don't see any reason why you'd have to take the mask off.
I see. You may be right.
You don't hear the mask talking to you anymore, do you? You're back to your old self.
I just realized, I haven't even asked your name.
It's Akiyama.
Well, Akiyama-san. If I'm not wearing this mask the next time I go up against you, you wouldn't know me, would you?
I guess I wouldn't.
Then I'll keep it on. And one day we'll meet again after I've honed my skills further.
Wait for me at the Victory Road finals. Until then, good luck.
Homura Kongo is always ready to take up a challenge! Come and get it!
Looks like I don't need to hold back against you. Okay, let's do this.
I hope you can put up a good fight! Here goes!
No, it'll have to wait.
You know where to find me! Come back when you're game!
Man! I pushed my strength to the limit, and now nobody wants to take me on!
(I'm not sure I want to deal with this guy.)
What's this!? I sense a dangerous soul!
Who're you!? State your name!
Hey, I was just...
That worn-out suit! That stubbled face! You must be Shun Akiyama!
I heard all about you from those I've defeated! They say you're pretty tough!
I'm Homura Kongo! A martial artist, through and through!
Umm...

en: Word is, you're the last guy in this town anywhere close to giving me a real challenge!
I'm honored, I guess.
Once I've taken you down, I'll be on to the Victory Road finals!
But I couldn't care less about that! I just want to gauge my own abilities!
Meaning?
I pushed myself to the brink of death while training!
But now that I'm here and putting those skills to use, there hasn't been a single fighter with the fortitude to stand against me!
How am I supposed to put my skills to the test if all my opponents fall to a single blow!?
You are the last hope I've got for that! I hope you have the strength to match me!
I... see.
Homura Kongo is always ready to take up a challenge! Come and get me!
*huff* *huff* That's the way it's done! Finally, I have been bested! This is wonderful!
Huh? Wonderful?
Knowing there's someone stronger than me makes all the training worth it! Now I've got a reason to hone my skills further!
Heh, I'm not who you need to worry about. I've seen plenty of guys stronger than me.
When you stay up in the mountains all the time, you miss all the stuff going on down at ground level. The world's bigger than you think it is.
And if I make it to the Victory Road finals, I'll get to meet these men?
Probably.
Hahaha! Perfect! That's the best news I've heard so far!
That's what I'll set my sights on now! The Victory Road! I've still got plenty of unlocked potential!
All right! Time waits for no man! Farewell for now, Akiyama!
(He's an odd one, all right...)
Well done, Akiyama-san.
You one of the Victory Road people?
Indeed. I help run the tournament. With this win, you've passed the qualifiers, Akiyama-san.
There is nobody left in this town who can defeat you. You've made it through to the Victory Road finals.
The Victory Road finals, huh?
They'll be held at the Underground Coliseum, where all the strongest fighters gather.
Go there once all the competitors have been decided.
So where is this Underground Coliseum?
In the country's greatest pleasure quarter. Fate has a way of bringing the most powerful fighters together there.
I must be going now. Good luck on the road ahead, Akiyama-san.
Hey, you! Let's battle it out for the Victory Road! *hic*
Whoa, hold up! You're totally hammered! Are you one of those drunken masters?
Shaddup! I'm an ex-wrestler! Better watch your mouth!
Gah! S'all over fer me. *hic* I can't even beat a clown like this!
Who are you calling a clown? You should take a look at yourself first.
Shaddup! I may not seem like much now, but you're looking at the great Kenichi Washino.
I have no idea who that is.
Damn amateur. They called me a rising star back in my pro wrestling days. I had a bright future ahead of me.
Then, right after I made my debut, an opponent pulled an illegal move on me and put me in the hospital. That was the end of my career!
Sounds like a familiar story. Are you telling me that's why you turned to the bottle?
Course it is! Can't make it through this life sober, that's for sure!
Bah, I'm done. *hic* Once ya fall, there's no going back! No second chances for losers in this world!
I get the feeling ya know what I'm talking about, huh? No point wasting time struggling! Join me and give up on life right now!
I'm not like you.
Just because you had a setback doesn't give you the right to get drunk and try to drag others down. Not everyone gives up that easily.
A guy like you would've ended up like this even if you hadn't got injured.
What!? But this is all the fault of that guy who broke the rules!
There you go, placing the blame on others. Have you actually ever made an effort yourself, and tried to change your life?
What's yer name, anyway?
It's Shinada. Tatsuo Shinada.
I've had about all the lip I can take from you, Shinada! I'm gonna show ya what happens when I play for keeps. Got it? You just wait.
(Uh oh, he looked pretty serious at the end there. Man, this is gonna suck...)
Hey, Shinada! Remember me?
It's Washino! The ex-wrestler! I got myself sober. Now I've come to give you a taste of what I can really do!
You look like a changed man. It's a big improvement.
I still remember all the shit you were talking before. Too late to take it all back now!
*huff* *huff* Hahaha!
So I lost again, huh? You're a tough customer, Shinada.
You didn't do so bad yourself. If you'd been training all along, I doubt I could have beat you.
It hurts knowing that I lost even though I gave my all. I haven't felt this way in so long.
I know it's frustrating, but I bet it feels good in a way, too.
Yeah, you might be right.
It's just part of the process.
I think I'm going to give this life another shot. I want to find a way into the Victory Road ring... To feel the spotlight on me again.
I think that's a great goal.
Thanks, Shinada. You've given me a new outlook on life... and a second chance.
No need to thank me. I probably didn't have any right to say those things to you, either.
Go on ahead to the Victory Road finals. I'll claw my way up there eventually, just you watch!
When I get there, maybe we could even team up!
You better wait for me!
(That attitude's gonna put him in fighting shape in no time.)
Hey! Are you taking part in the Victory Road?
Yeah, why?
The name's Shoji Yonashiro, and I'm here to kick yer ass!
You don't sound like a local. You from out of town?
Yeah, I been travelin' around a lot to train. Picked up little, tiny bits of the dialects here and there and everywhere.
No kidding? I guess you're probably tougher than you look, then.
Nah, I ain't much more than your run-of-the-mill martial artist, ya feel me? Anyway, let's get ready to rumble!
Man! This Victory Road thing ain't a piece of cake, it's the whole thing! You ever try to eat a whole cake? Not easy!
Guess I'd better uncap myself.
Uh... Meaning?
You know, uncap myself. Unleash my true potential? Become as strong as I always knew I could be?
Oh, so you were holding back after all? I was wondering why a guy who trained all over the country seemed so weak.
Hah! Well spotted, spot!
When I uncap myself, I turn into Hyper Yonashiro! Hoo-hah! But it takes time to recharge when the fight's done.
Hyper... What?
I wanted to save it for when my ass was against the wall and in danger of gettin' kicked, but I think that moment came and went just now. So give me another shot and I'll show ya what I can do!
Okay, fine by me.
Awesome, possum! Then let's go! In, like, a while. Chargers gonna charge and stuff.
Smell ya later, duderino!
(This guy's cap might be on a little too tight. Can't say I don't like him, though.)
Hey, you're here! Wanna rematch, buddy boy?
Great! Time to uncap myself so I can become Hyper Yonashiro!
Wait just a hot second!
Maybe some other time.
Anytime you're ready. You know where to find me, friendo!
Shit! Using a weapon like that has got to be against the rules!
What do you mean? You can use any weapon other than guns in the Victory Road.
Even so, that thing gives you too much of an advantage!
Heh. I'll take that as a compliment.
Dammit... Screw this!
You're Tatsuo Shinada-san, aren't you?
That's right. Though this isn't exactly what I pictured myself being famous for...
My name is Inzen Hozoin. I'm taking part in the Victory Road to show the world the power of the Hozoin style of spear fighting.
And if I defeat you, I will be granted entry into the Victory Road finals. Will you take up my challenge, Shinada-san?
Wait, you're ready to fight again already?
I'm good to go. That last opponent made for a perfect warm-up.
Ha. Pretty impressive.
It seems we have company here, though.
You two are getting too cocky. You shouldn't show off like that.
I remember you. Wait, are you all Victory Road participants?
Who cares about that now!? This goes for you in particular, spear man! Your cowardly use of that thing is the worst!
Like I've said, the use of weapons is sanctioned under the rules. There's no foul play involved.
Shut it! We just want a fair fight, so the two of you are going to have to go!
But you outnumber us, man! How is that fair?
There's no talking sense into them, Shinada-san. We'll have to take out these guys first.
That seems to be all of them, Shinada.
I can't help feeling like I got caught in the crossfire here.
In any case, that just leaves you. It's time for us to settle things.
You still want to do this?
Of course. Brace yourself!
I am defeated. You are a formidable opponent.
If my eyes do not deceive me, you seem to be an old hand at competitive events like this.
I wouldn't go that far.
No need to be modest. I am a master of Hozoin spearmanship. It does me no favors when one who has bested me belittles himself.
